I wrote `component.html` in the folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so I haven't checked the layout.

The folder had four files. `prompt.txt` is your request and `BRAND.md` has the brand notes. `session.json` and `session.err` are empty. I followed `BRAND.md`.

- **Layout:** The whole screen sits in `<div id="component">` at 1280px wide. It is static HTML and CSS with no JavaScript.
- **Content:** It has the "People" heading, the "Add Person" button, a search field labeled "Search people", and the five people. Each person has name, title, department and email, with the email as a `mailto:` link.
- **Brand:**
  - **Colours:** The page has a white background, text in ink `#0B1416`, and `#0263AC` as the only accent.
  - **Fonts:** The heading uses Unbounded Light in capitals. The body uses Archivo.
  - **Fallback fonts:** There are no font files in the folder, so both fonts fall back to system fonts unless they're installed on the viewer's machine.
- **Warm and welcoming:** I used rounded pill-shaped button, search field and department tags, roomy cards, and a blue accent edge on each card. I kept to the brand palette, so the warmth comes from shape and spacing rather than extra colours.
- **Accessibility:** The search field has a visible label, the focus outlines are strong, and the text contrast is high.

`BRAND.md` describes your portfolio site (shauna.dev), not Harbor. I followed it because you asked me to. If Harbor has its own brand, tell me and I'll switch to it.
